description: Reopen a previously closed billing month, allowing time to be logged and edited again. Call once with no token to preview; re-call with the returned confirm_token and an idempotency_key to commit. Reversible only by closing the month again.

confirm_token.description: Token returned by the preview (call this tool once with no token to get it). Required to commit; expires in ~10 minutes.

idempotency_key.description: Required when committing (confirm_token present): retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

year.description: Calendar year of the month to reopen (e.g. 2026).

name: reopen_month
